batch_caliber_conflict.recommendation: run F0b at batch 4 and record that F0a's 200-step batch-8 run is not interchangeable
batch_caliber_conflict.why_it_matters: episode-exposure and per-update cost both scale with batch; F0b must run at the F1 batch (4) or its price cannot be transplanted

f0a_reference_not_to_be_reused.why_not_reusable: F0a ran on cached features with model_calls=0, so it never paid the full producer/V4/decoder cost; the 0.59 cpu s/update is a component floor, not the candidate cost

sizing_rule.hard_stop: on envelope exhaustion write the summary and stop; no top-up, no extra epoch
sizing_rule.risk: at N177.6 measured 24.7-45.8 cpu s/update for the joint chain, 166.7 cpu s/run allows only ~3-6 updates after load+restore overhead
sizing_rule.rule: run 1 measures per-update cost over a fixed 2-update window; the remaining 11 runs are sized so their projected cost stays under the per-run allowance

exclusivity.lock: reuse the run_root.lock pattern (O_EXCL + live-owner check + stale lock kept for forensics)
exclusivity.resource_gates: CPU double-sample <=85% and available memory >=8 GiB before each run, re-measured not inherited
exclusivity.serial: one run at a time; no training, no evaluation and no other calibration concurrently

exposure_caliber.conflict: SPEC §4 writes '1,280 updates（5 个 128-episode epoch，batch 4）'; 128 episodes at batch 4 is 32 updates/epoch, so 5 epochs is 160 updates, while 1,280 updates is 40 epochs
exposure_caliber.ratio: A is 8x B in both updates and episode-exposures
exposure_caliber.recommendation: A (1,280): it is the literal number the frozen text commits to, and 160 updates sits near F0a's 200-step scale which already saturated copy_only; B should only be chosen if the owner re-prices F1 downward

must_not: tune any threshold from partial results
add epochs, seeds or topics on failure
treat F0a's 118.25 cpu s as the full-candidate estimate
open_owner_decisions: confirm the 12-run list (4 arms x 3 seeds) as the F0b surface
accept the measured-first sizing rule, or grant a larger envelope so each run can do more updates
per_run_protocol: zero checkpoint saved before any update, then fresh-process restore of that zero
warmup window not counted; measured window starts after warmup
durable checkpoint at every 256 updates, at the course boundary, and at the endpoint
endpoint fresh-process restore, then replay one fixed input and require identical parse/feature/answer
record process_cpu_seconds and wall_seconds separately; never pool them
